articles.title: French company abandons crypto treasury strategy, will liquidate Bitcoin holdings
articles.snippet: In the year since Sequans Communications announced that it would adopt a digital asset treasury strategy, the price of Bitcoin fell by more than 30%.

articles.title: Crypto companies have tightened compliance, but gaps remain: Chainalysis
articles.snippet: Around 47% of crypto organizations onboarded in 2026 are operating at alerting standards that would have ranked among the industry’s strictest five years ago.

articles.title: CFTC seeks to reverse settlement deal with Gemini
articles.snippet: The CFTC claimed that its settled complaint filed under the Biden administration relied heavily on a whistleblower’s allegations that Gemini inflated trading activity to distort user demand.

articles.title: Standard Chartered Reaffirms $40K Ethereum Price Target Due to DeFi Dominance
articles.snippet: Analysts compared Ethereum's current position to Amazon following the dot-com bubble burst.

articles.title: This AI Compressed 'All Human Cooking' Into 2 Megabytes
articles.snippet: A London startup trained an AI on 4.1 million recipes across seven languages—and the whole thing is smaller than a song file.
